name: Bokura no Hyaku Monogatari - Nigiyaka na Dokuyaku Hen
original_name: ぼくらの百物語 にぎやかな毒薬篇
source:
The high school I go to is famous for its theater. The reason it produces so many famous actors is because they did some weird ritual. (Purification of Deus Ex Machina)
If you reverse the food chain, a curse gets activated. (The Curse of Reverse Circulation)
For some reason, the curry and fried chicken from the school cafeteria where nobody eats have a passionate fanbase. (The Urban Legend of Fried Chicken and Curry)

This is the first installment of the Hyakumonogatari series, featuring nine completely original scary stories plus one title story that can only be unlocked by meeting specific conditions—totaling ten stories.

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1371557]booth[/url]]
translation:
我就读的高中以戏剧闻名。据说校内之所以能培养出那么多知名演员，是因为他们举行过某种奇怪的仪式。（机械降神的净化）
只要颠倒食物链，诅咒就会被触发。（逆循环之咒）
不知道为什么，明明没人吃的学校食堂咖喱和炸鸡，却有一群狂热粉丝。（炸鸡与咖喱的都市传说）

这是《百物语》系列的第一作，收录九篇完全原创的恐怖故事，以及一篇只有满足特定条件才能解锁的标题故事，共计十篇。

[译自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1371557]booth[/url]]
